Mastery of the Earth: The Living Tradition of Naraguta Pottery

By Women's Craft Collective & Grace Azi

Along the seasonal streams of Naraguta lies rich alluvial clay. For generations, Anaguta women have harnessed this earth to mold pots celebrated for their thermal resilience and graceful geometric designs.

Coiling and Firing

Shaped entirely by hand without a wheel, pots are dried in the plateau sun and fired in open pits with elephant grass. The resulting terracotta pieces maintain water at natural cool temperatures even in the height of the dry season.
